proposal: Switch equity momentum rebalance from weekly to monthly (first Monday of the month), keep the 63d signal, top-10 buffer, and all caps. First monthly rebalance 2026-11-02.
logic: Options: (1) keep weekly with buffer, (2) monthly cadence, (3) switch to weekly mean reversion (+17.04% 1y but 10.8x turnover and a method switch), (4) drop to SPY buy-and-hold. Monthly ties weekly over 1y, beats it by 3.4 pts over 3m, has a shallower drawdown, and a third less turnover. It is a cadence change only, so the experiment still tests momentum. Mean reversion stays a shadow until the planned 11-02 checkpoint.
how_to_judge: Four monthly rebalances (Nov to Feb). Keep the weekly shadow in the Monday scorecard. Revert if monthly trails the weekly shadow by more than 1.5 pts or adds more than 1 pt of drawdown.
